status: prospective source contract frozen after row-1-only schema audit and before any numeric ALTITUDE magnitude is parsed

source.vertical_semantics: elevation above sea level in metres; source code 0 means GPS failed to retrieve altitude

outcome_blind_vertical_operation: ALTITUDE may be read only as a raw string to classify source-coded missingness (blank/NA/0 versus present); no numeric conversion, summary, sorting or plotting is allowed before the opening receipt

row_qualification.rule: retain rows with all required nonvertical fields, nonzero parseable longitude/latitude, and ALTITUDE not equal to a frozen missing code; ALTITUDE magnitude remains unparsed

session.definition: Local x individual x source date

cohort_admission.reason: self/other identity exchangeability is evaluated within source-native roost locality rather than across geographically distinct roosts

projection.rule: determine a UTM EPSG separately for each admitted Local from that Local's median nonvertical longitude/latitude; fixed native UTM origin

horizontal_individuality.self_profile: equal other eligible sessions of same individual within Local
horizontal_individuality.other_profile: pool sessions within each other individual in the same Local then equal-weight other individuals
horizontal_individuality.session_score: mean target-event log P_self(cell) - log P_other(cell), Jeffreys-smoothed over the frozen Local cell universe
horizontal_individuality.aggregation: equal target session within individual then equal individual across source
horizontal_individuality.null: whole-session identity permutation within Local preserving exact session-count multiset per identity

vertical_preflight.training_universe: all >=50-fix sessions of repeat-eligible individuals in admitted Local cohorts
vertical_preflight.target_common_support: target 5-km cell present in at least one other training session of same individual and at least one training session of another individual within Local
vertical_preflight.estimator_evaluable_individual: at least one target session with >=50 common-support events
freeze_before_altitude: exact vertically evaluable target sessions and supported-event counts

vertical_primary.centering: subtract full frozen session median ALTITUDE before binning
vertical_primary.self_profile: equal other frozen sessions of same individual within Local
vertical_primary.other_profile: pool sessions within each other individual within Local then equal-weight other individuals
vertical_primary.common_cell_weighting: identical self-derived common-cell weights for self and other profiles
vertical_primary.aggregation: equal target session within individual then equal individual across source
vertical_primary.null: whole-session identity permutation within Local over frozen training universe; replay full support/profile/weighting pipeline
vertical_primary.pass_rule: calibrated excess > 0 and one-sided p(null >= observed) <= 0.05

claim_boundary: This is a new prospective source; historical vampire-bat results are not part of the original batter archive.
Altitude is above sea level, not AGL. Session centering and horizontal matching do not fully remove terrain-reference limitations.
Sparse mountainous GPS sampling is a fixed source property.
A source structural FAIL or vertical FAIL is retained without lowering thresholds, pooling localities, alternate bins, absolute-altitude rescue or individual exclusions.
Horizontal individuality is reported independently of the later vertical result.
